definitions.cohort: Entrenched rulers only, grouped by verified resident/military origin or initial month zero; remaining enthroned rulers are successors. Ordinary unenthroned kin excluded.
definitions.naturalIncidence: Deaths from actual natural death records. 12/24 month denominator includes all entrants with complete observation, including competing political outcomes. This is person-life incidence, not polity survival.
definitions.tenure: Completed political tenure only; living or deceased after political end counted separately; ongoing tenures censored.
definitions.oldExpiredSamples: z9 creation-time forwarded RNG observation of the two original lifetime draws, not a replay or extra draw. Candidate does not use that sampler.
definitions.oldAgeTail: Resident-only conditional lifespan retains original 45–84 band masses, spreads dates over months, and replaces last 5% finite 85–92 band with an open increasing-hazard old-age tail. Ordinary population mortality and military schedules are not changed.
definitions.rng: Resident sampler consumes one draw instead of two. Later RNG paths and histories differ; no event-by-event equivalence assumed.
